site.name: Thomas Iwainski - Senior Software Engineer
site.description:
I'm a passionate Senior Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience in building scalable, high-performance desktop and web applications. My expertise lies in C# and .NET as well as the JavaScript ecosystem, particularly with React, Next.js, and Node.js. I thrive in collaborative environments and am always eager to tackle complex challenges and learn new technologies.

As a Senior Software Engineer currently at SSW, I have been at the forefront of leading and modernizing internal and client-facing software projects. My experience spans across diverse industries including technology consulting, winery operations, web management, and software development agencies.

Currently serving as a Senior Software Engineer and Tech Lead at SSW, where I lead the development of cutting-edge software solutions, manage cross-functional teams, and contribute to innovative AI-powered products like [YakShaver](https://yakshaver.ai).
